elements.name: Aquarius
elements.text: Aquarius: idealistic, nonconformist vision, moving to its own rhythm toward hope.

elements.name: Star halo
elements.text: The eight-pointed star crowning her: the light seen at the end of the tunnel, hope made luminous.

elements.name: Vessel
elements.text: The vessel raised in her hand: an open-handed gift poured out into the world, faith offered without needing anything back.

rounds.text: A woman pours water onto both earth and river, an act that feeds the ground while also serving something purely ideal, {b1}, and shared intention. Aquarius carries a double {b2}: airy and lucid, yet emotionally tied to Water. Ruled by Uranus, the only planet spinning on its side, Aquarius marches to its own rhythm, valuing collective good over individual will. In the Star, that uniqueness becomes hope itself, an openness to life and nature.
